femoco54.qpe_basis: T and A from the compiled controlled walk, M from the walk (`--large femoco54`, once each per code hash): T = (2^t - 1) T_C(W) + (t^3 - t)/6, M = (2^t - 1) M_W + t and A = (2^t - 1) A_C(W) + (t^3 - t)/6, every correction at its maximum branch.
